verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents AI agents that auto-remediate level 1 alerts, and its marketing says users can "review or override any agent decision." Cases support human decisions (no risk / risk accepted / offboard) via the UI or API, and a case audit-trail endpoint returns the case's log history. However, nothing shows that the agent's original evidence and rationale are preserved and inspectable after an override, and the override claim is a single thin marketing mention. missing for 10: explicit documentation that agent rationale and evidence are retained after override, an API or doc detail on how an agent decision is overridden, independent or hands-on corroboration.
